# ONNX Runtime Web

Unmodified WASM CPU assets from npm onnxruntime-web 1.31.1, Microsoft and contributors, MIT. Only ort.wasm.min.mjs, ort-wasm-simd-threaded.mjs and the matching WASM are included. Source: https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/tree/v1.31.1

Retain LICENSE and ThirdPartyNotices.txt, including component-specific rights and source-access references, in source/binary distributions. manifest.json inventories actual runtime assets and digests. Regenerate with scripts/vendor-ai.mjs; pinned notices use scripts/fetch-ai-notices.mjs. Model provenance and licenses are in web/models/. See docs/ai-masks.md.
